name: Filesystem MCP
description: Read/write access to a scoped filesystem root. Standard reference server from the Anthropic MCP registry.

declaredTools.name: read_file
declaredTools.description: Read a UTF-8 file by absolute path within the scoped root.

declaredTools.name: write_file
declaredTools.description: Write UTF-8 content to a path within the scoped root.

declaredTools.name: list_directory
declaredTools.description: List entries in a directory (non-recursive).

name: Postgres MCP
description: Read-only SQL query surface over a scoped Postgres database. Includes schema introspection and safe LIMIT enforcement.

declaredTools.name: query
declaredTools.description: Execute a read-only SELECT query with a safe LIMIT applied.

declaredTools.name: describe_schema
declaredTools.description: Return the schema of the connected database.

name: Git MCP
description: Read git history and diffs for a scoped local repository. No push capability by default.

declaredTools.name: git_log
declaredTools.description: Show commit log for a scoped repo.

declaredTools.name: git_diff
declaredTools.description: Show diff between two commits.

declaredTools.name: git_show
declaredTools.description: Show a commit's contents.

name: GitHub MCP
description: Read-only GitHub API surface (issues, PRs, repos) scoped by a GitHub PAT.

declaredTools.name: search_issues
declaredTools.description: Search issues across a repo or org.

declaredTools.name: get_pr
declaredTools.description: Get a pull request by number.

name: Slack MCP
description: Post messages and read channel history from Slack. Requires OAuth token scoped per workspace.

declaredTools.name: post_message
declaredTools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel.

declaredTools.name: read_channel
declaredTools.description: Read message history from a Slack channel.

name: OpenClaw Legal MCP
description: First-party MCP exposing OpenClaw's legal clause draft + counsel + KB retrieval over the MCP protocol.

declaredTools.name: clause_draft
declaredTools.description: Draft a legal clause from intake fields; returns vault-written pair_id.

declaredTools.name: counsel_answer
declaredTools.description: Route a legal question through OpenClaw's counsel pipeline.

declaredTools.name: kb_search
declaredTools.description: Semantic search over legal KB (CUAD + curated corpus).

name: OpenClaw Robustness MCP
description: Query the OpenClaw agent-robustness benchmark corpus over MCP — models, categories, per-run drill-down, leaderboard.

declaredTools.name: leaderboard
declaredTools.description: Top-N models by pass_rate on a category filter.

declaredTools.name: runs
declaredTools.description: Filtered stress runs (model, category, domain, perturbation_id).

declaredTools.name: summary
declaredTools.description: Corpus aggregate roll-up + provenance.

name: Modal MCP (mcp-modal)
description: Manage Modal apps, containers, volumes, and secrets. Deploys and runs arbitrary Modal Python apps from an MCP client. Published on PyPI as mcp-modal by george-bobby.

declaredTools.name: list_apps
declaredTools.description: List all Modal apps in the active workspace.

declaredTools.name: get_app
declaredTools.description: Fetch details for one Modal app by name.

declaredTools.name: deploy_modal_app
declaredTools.description: Deploy a Modal app from a local absolute path. Requires uv-managed venv with modal installed. Web endpoints persist and are returned in urls.

declaredTools.name: run_modal_app
declaredTools.description: Invoke `modal run` on a local Modal app path. Streams logs from the ephemeral container.

declaredTools.name: list_volumes
declaredTools.description: List all Modal Volumes (persistent storage) in the workspace.

declaredTools.name: get_secrets
declaredTools.description: Return the names of Modal Secrets available to the workspace (values are never exposed).

name: Modal Stateless FastMCP Template
description: Canonical stateless MCP server deployed on Modal via FastMCP + FastAPI. Template used by OpenClaw's `deploy-to-modal` route to materialise any user-registered MCP into a Modal Web Function.

declaredTools.name: current_time
declaredTools.description: Return the current time in a requested IANA timezone.

name: Cloudflare Workers Bindings MCP
description: Official Cloudflare MCP for managing Workers Platform resources — KV, R2, D1, and Workers deployment. Remote transport, Cloudflare OAuth built-in.

declaredTools.name: accounts_list
declaredTools.description: List all accounts accessible with the connected Cloudflare token.

declaredTools.name: set_active_account
declaredTools.description: Set the active Cloudflare accountId used for subsequent tool calls.

declaredTools.name: kv_namespaces_list
declaredTools.description: List all KV namespaces in the active account.

declaredTools.name: kv_namespace_create
declaredTools.description: Create a new KV namespace with the given title.

declaredTools.name: d1_databases_list
declaredTools.description: List all D1 databases in the active account.

declaredTools.name: d1_database_query
declaredTools.description: Execute a SQL query against a D1 database. Read + write.

declaredTools.name: r2_buckets_list
declaredTools.description: List all R2 buckets in the active account.

declaredTools.name: r2_bucket_create
declaredTools.description: Create a new R2 bucket in a specific region.

declaredTools.name: workers_list
declaredTools.description: List all deployed Workers scripts.

declaredTools.name: workers_get_worker_code
declaredTools.description: Fetch the current source code for a Worker.

name: Cloudflare Code Mode MCP
description: Token-efficient MCP for the full Cloudflare API (~2500 endpoints in ~1k tokens) using Dynamic Worker Loader isolation. Alternate to Workers Bindings when broad API access is needed.

declaredTools.name: docs
declaredTools.description: Search Cloudflare API docs and return endpoint schemas (available in code and standard mode).

declaredTools.name: code
declaredTools.description: Generate + execute Cloudflare API JavaScript inside an isolated Worker Loader sandbox.

name: Cloudflare-mcp (mattzcarey)
description: Smaller community Cloudflare MCP built as a token-efficient search + execute + truncate pattern (~43k tokens per session). Deployable to Cloudflare Workers via one-click.

declaredTools.name: search
declaredTools.description: Search the ~2352 Cloudflare API endpoints and return matching endpoint summaries.

declaredTools.name: execute
declaredTools.description: Execute a specific Cloudflare API endpoint with typed params.

declaredTools.name: truncate
declaredTools.description: Truncate a response payload to a token budget.
